items.source: One way to address this is to look for a checkbox parameter value if you know that the checkbox has been visible in the form, resetting the checkbox if no value found. In Spring web MVC, this typically happens in a custom onBind implementation.
items.translation: 解决此问题的一种方法是，如果您知道复选框在表单中可见，则查找复选框参数值，若未找到值则重置该复选框。在 Spring Web MVC 中，这通常发生在自定义 `onBind` 实现中。

items.source:
Includes support for field markers which address a common problem with
HTML checkboxes and select options: detecting that a field was part of
the form, but did not generate a request parameter because it was empty.
A field marker allows to detect that state and reset the corresponding
bean property accordingly. Default values, for parameters that are otherwise
not present, can specify a value for the field other than empty.
items.translation: 包含对字段标记的支持，以解决 HTML 复选框和下拉选项中的一个常见问题：检测到某个字段属于表单，但由于为空而未生成请求参数。字段标记允许检测该状态并相应地重置对应的 Bean 属性。对于其他情况下不存在的参数，默认值可以指定除空以外的字段值。

items.source:
Such a marker parameter indicates that the field was visible, that is,
existed in the form that caused the submission. If no corresponding field
value parameter was found, the field will be reset. The value of the field
marker parameter does not matter in this case; an arbitrary value can be used.
This is particularly useful for HTML checkboxes and select options.
items.translation: 此类标记参数表示该字段可见，即存在于导致提交的表单中。如果未找到对应的字段值参数，则该字段将被重置。在这种情况下，字段标记参数的值无关紧要；可以使用任意值。这对于 HTML 复选框和选择选项尤其有用。

items.source:
Default parameters differ from field markers in that they provide a default
value instead of an empty value.
items.translation: 默认参数与字段标记不同，它们提供的是默认值而非空值。

items.source:
Default is "_", for "_FIELD" parameters (for example, "_subscribeToNewsletter").
Set this to null if you want to turn off the empty field check completely.
items.translation: 默认值为 "_"，用于"_FIELD" 参数（例如，"_subscribeToNewsletter"）。如果希望完全关闭空字段检查，请将此值设置为 null。

items.source:
HTML checkboxes only send a value when they're checked, so it is not
possible to detect that a formerly checked box has just been unchecked,
at least not with standard HTML means.
items.translation: 复选框仅在选中时发送值，因此无法检测到之前已选中的复选框刚刚被取消选中，至少在标准 HTML 手段下是不可能的。

items.source:
This auto-reset mechanism addresses this deficiency, provided
that a marker parameter is sent for each checkbox field, like
"_subscribeToNewsletter" for a "subscribeToNewsletter" field.
As the marker parameter is sent in any case, the data binder can
detect an empty field and automatically reset its value.
items.translation: 此自动重置机制解决了这一缺陷，前提是对于每个复选框字段都发送一个标记参数，例如对于 "subscribeToNewsletter" 字段发送 "_subscribeToNewsletter"。由于标记参数无论如何都会发送，数据绑定器可以检测到空字段并自动将其值重置。

items.source:
Default is "!", for "!FIELD" parameters (for example, "!subscribeToNewsletter").
Set this to null if you want to turn off the field defaults completely.
items.translation: 默认值为 "!"，用于 "!FIELD" 参数（例如，"!subscribeToNewsletter")。如果您想完全关闭字段默认值，请将此值设置为 null。

items.source:
HTML checkboxes only send a value when they're checked, so it is not
possible to detect that a formerly checked box has just been unchecked,
at least not with standard HTML means.  A default field is especially
useful when a checkbox represents a non-boolean value.
items.translation: HTML 复选框仅在选中时发送值，因此无法检测到刚刚取消选中的复选框（至少使用标准 HTML 手段无法做到）。当复选框代表非布尔值时，默认字段尤其有用。

items.source:
The presence of a default parameter preempts the behavior of a field
marker for the given field.
items.translation: 默认参数的存在会阻止给定字段的字段标记行为。

items.source:
Turn this off if you want to keep an already bound MultipartFile
when the user resubmits the form without choosing a different file.
Else, the already bound MultipartFile will be replaced by an empty
MultipartFile holder.
items.translation: 如果您希望用户在重新提交表单且未选择不同文件时保留已绑定的 `MultipartFile`，请关闭此功能。否则，已绑定的 `MultipartFile` 将被一个空的 `MultipartFile` 持有器替换。

items.source:
The existence of a field defaults indicates that the specified
value should be used if the field is otherwise not present.
items.translation: 字段默认值的存在表明，如果该字段不存在，则应使用指定的值。

items.source:
The existence of a field marker indicates that the specified
field existed in the form. If the property values do not contain
a corresponding field value, the field will be considered as empty
and will be reset appropriately.
items.translation: 字段标记的存在表明指定的字段在表单中存在。如果属性值不包含相应的字段值，该字段将被视为空并适当重置。

items.source: WARNING: Data binding can lead to security issues by exposing parts of the object graph that are not meant to be accessed or modified by external clients. Therefore, the design and use of data binding should be considered carefully with regard to security. For more details, please refer to the dedicated sections on data binding for Spring Web MVC and Spring WebFlux in the reference manual.
items.translation: 警告： 数据绑定可能导致安全问题，因为它会暴露外部客户端不应访问或修改的对象图部分。因此，在设计和使用数据绑定时，应仔细考虑其安全性。有关详细信息，请参阅参考手册中关于 Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 的数据绑定专用章节： Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux。
